formulations.Polymer system Notes: PTMC synthesized via bulk ring-opening polymerization of trimethylene carbonate with Sn(Oct)2 catalyst. M_n = 368,000 g/mol, PDI = 1.36.
formulations.Notes: Conductivity data read from Fig. 2a (VTF fits) and Fig. 2b (salt concentration dependence). Tg of pure PTMC read from Fig. 3b text description (-15 °C). Salt ratios: n=2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21 (PTMC_nLiTFSI). Best conductivity at 1:13 and 1:8 ratios. Electrochemical stability up to 5.0 V vs Li/Li+. Cycling tested at 60 °C.
formulations.Reference: Sun, B., Mindemark, J., Edström, K., & Brandell, D. (2013). Polycarbonate-based solid polymer electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. Solid State Ionics, 242, 1-7.

formulations.Notes: Specific formulation PTMC_8LiTFSI (ratio 8:1 carbonate:Li). Used for electrochemical stability (Fig. 4) and cycling tests (Fig. 5, Fig. 6). Conductivity at 60°C ~10^-7 S/cm (read from Fig. 2a/b).
formulations.Reference: Sun, B., Mindemark, J., Edström, K., & Brandell, D. (2013). Polycarbonate-based solid polymer electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. Solid State Ionics, 242, 1-7.
